notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Available
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Wild Guns Reloaded!
 
We have just released an updated version that fixes the issue of Kaspersky anti-virus software.
 
We hope everyone enjoys the game and we're always reading the CommunityHub so don't hesitate to leave feedback!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Wild Guns Reloaded, 25% off!
notes.content:
Wild Guns Reloaded is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

Wild Guns Reloaded is a fast-paced arcade-style shooter, mixing the Wild West with steampunk. Play as Clint, Annie, Doris, or Bullet the dog with his sentry drone. Grab some friends and play together for some four player action!

*Offer ends July 18 at 10AM Pacific Time
